name: Stereotypes
overview: Scripture warns against judging others based on superficial appearances or preconceived notions, urging believers to exercise righteous judgment rather than condemning hastily or unfairly. God reminds His people that all share one Creator and Father, calling for unity and faithfulness rather than treachery and slander among brothers. The example of Nicodemus, a Pharisee, illustrates that titles and reputation do not define a person's heart or standing before God. Ultimately, believers are commanded to avoid harmful stereotypes and gossip, recognizing the dignity and worth of every neighbor as made by the Lord.
